aboutGame.title: What is Can You Find Everything?
paragraphs: Can You Find Everything is a hidden-object scavenger game on Roblox where players explore detailed maps and hunt for cleverly concealed items. Every zone is packed with collectibles, from tiny fairies and screws to seasonal presents, dog tags and crayons that blend into the scenery.

Our fan-made wiki maps each area, tracks every item category and breaks down secret rooms, movement mechanics and updates so you can reach 100% completion. Whether you are following the beginner guide or chasing the last missing collectible, every page is built to shorten the hunt.

highlights.detail: Learn camera movement, field of view and interaction hitboxes before hunting rare items.
Raise brightness and turn on object highlighting so camouflaged props stand out.
Sweep each room in three bands: floor level, eye level and overhead.
Trace the walls clockwise and keep your back to the wall to capture the full scene.
Clear the current zone before triggering any point of no return.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Can You Find Everything.

items.question: What is Can You Find Everything?
items.answer: Can You Find Everything is a hidden-object scavenger game on Roblox. Players explore detailed maps and search for cleverly concealed items, from tiny fairies and screws to seasonal presents and dog tags, while working toward 100% completion.

items.question: How do I find every item in Can You Find Everything?
items.answer: Sweep each room in three bands, floor, eye level and overhead, then trace the walls clockwise before checking central furniture. Turn on object highlighting and raise brightness so camouflaged props stand out, and clear the current zone before triggering any point of no return.

items.question: Does Can You Find Everything have codes?
items.answer: Yes. Can You Find Everything codes are redeemed through the Codes or Rewards icon in the hub. Codes are case-sensitive, so paste them exactly with no trailing spaces, and redeem event codes quickly because they can expire within a day or two.

items.question: Where are the secret areas in Can You Find Everything?
items.answer: Secret areas in Can You Find Everything include the Backrooms, the Rabbit Hole chain, the Secret Hideout and Skeleton Key chests. Watch for false walls, breakable props and lighting anomalies that mark a hidden room.

items.question: Can I complete Can You Find Everything in one playthrough?
items.answer: Yes, most players can finish Can You Find Everything in a single run if they avoid points of no return. Before you cross a glowing doorway or follow an escape objective, turn around and clear the remaining items in the current zone, and check ceilings and under stairwells for stragglers.
